Goals
- Public launch and stabilization.

Tasks
- Launch
  - [ ] Execute launch checklist; communications; support channels ready.
- Monitoring/Alerting
  - [ ] Alerts tuned; dashboards monitored; backups verified.
- Bug Bash
  - [ ] Triage and fix P0/P1 issues; hotfix pipeline validated.
- Post-launch
  - [ ] Data retention and bucket lifecycle policies; cost checks.

Deliverables
- Stable production with monitoring and response playbooks.

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] No unresolved P0s for 72h; median error rate within target.
- [ ] Backups restorable; on-call runbook tested.
